entries: {SOMEONE:!threatening} met {first} at {landmark} {MANNER} with a spare suit.
{first} {ACT_PERSON} {SOMEONE:human}, but the {rival} had already locked {CLOSE:human} out of the network.
Each step toward {PRIZE:!inner} cost {first} another hour of air, and {VICE} cost more.
{first} tracked {THING:portable} to {landmark} and waited in the cold {MANNER}.
{the_someone} gave conflicting data about {TOPIC}, and {first} ran it again {MANNER}.
